tspan.tspan: The MOSES project aims to investigate metal oxidation and spin states through X-ray
Absorption Spectroscopy (XAS) and X-ray Emission Spectroscopy (XES), offering complementary insights into the electronic
structure. A prototype setup will be designed, integrating both techniques into a fully automated and motorized system.

text.tspan: Operando measurements on a working battery will serve as primary test-case application to showcase setup's capabilities.
